uwp_baseline.device_runtime_evidence: Previous signed builds, with package versions listed in the referenced evidence

target_runtime_verification: The baseline status cells describe the November 18 signed port. Candidate statuses and the cross-architecture report record direct November 20 measurements separately.

status_legend.U: Unsupported by the current UWP port
status_legend.G: Unsupported by the graphics backend or feature level

x64_dx11_fl91.description: x64 D3D11 compatibility path (bench tested on physical FL11_1)

x86_dx12.description: x86 D3D12 build route, runtime unverified

arm64_dx11_fl91.description: ARM64 D3D11 compatibility path, Surface Adreno 680

arm32_dx12.description: ARM32 D3D12 alternatives. Earlier device probe rejected available adapter

arm32_angle.description: ARM32 ANGLE alternatives. Earlier device EGL surface probe failed

features.official_behavior: Open and play a saved single-player world
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Integrated server and rendering were demonstrated in saved worlds on Surface D3D11 and Lumia. The Lumia passed a short run at two chunks. Existing x64 graphics evidence is multiplayer. It does not establish this exact signed build's single-player test.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Retest single player and clean exit on all four native targets.

features.official_behavior: Create a new local world with seed, presets and data packs
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: World creation UI and server machinery ship. Prior Lumia world creation was initially blocked by a renderer panic. The fixed run opened a saved world, leaving new-world creation and data pack options to test.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Create a disposable world per architecture, save, quit and reopen.

features.official_behavior: Survival, health, food, damage, mobs and progression
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Uses the shared game and integrated server. The evidence records world entry and input, without a matched survival progression or damage test.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Run a representative survival loop on desktop and mobile.

features.official_behavior: Creative mode, inventory, flight and building
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The three desktop renderers joined a mode-creative scene. The scene does not cover every creative inventory operation. Record the per-mode gameplay test separately.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify create, place, break, fly and inventory in isolated worlds.

features.official_behavior: Adventure, spectator and hardcore modes
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared world and rules code is carried. The baseline reports do not cover the three modes.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Exercise each mode and reopen the resulting saves.

features.official_behavior: Crafting, smelting, enchanting, trading, combat, redstone, farming, dimensions and boss/raid progression
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared engine behavior is inherited. None of the short hardware sessions is a cross-feature progression suite.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Run vanilla-parity harnesses and a small end-to-end gameplay suite against signed candidates.

features.official_behavior: Chunk generation, loading, meshing, uploads and persistence
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: ARM32 runs a compatibility path with constrained texture budget and upload batching. A 32-chunk run hit terrain allocation errors and device loss. Short two-chunk play succeeded. Surface D3D11 saved-world coverage is limited to the projected path.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Measure native target allocation and sustained play at increasing distances.

features.official_behavior: Java-format world data, operational saves, upgrades and restart
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The existing backup worlds stayed intact and opened on both ARM devices. Save-write, restart and version migrations need dedicated disjoint copies.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify edited world state after clean restart and compare save backups.

features.official_behavior: Vanilla commands, suggestions and operator actions
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared Brigadier/game command path is present. Server console teleports used in desktop graphics testing do not verify commands typed in the UWP client.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test client command dispatch, text entry, selectors and command suggestions.

features.official_behavior: Direct Connect and Java protocol multiplayer
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: All three x64 renderer runs joined the same matched scratch server. x86 was verified at title, and the ARM excerpts cover local worlds or title.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Join a matching server on x86 and both ARM devices, then verify movement, chat and disconnect.

features.official_behavior: Saved servers, discovery, status, LAN open/join and network advertisements
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The native launcher stores a server list and status, and x64 Direct Connect is proven. Client broadcast discovery, firewall/AppContainer behavior and LAN host/join across devices remain open.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test LAN host discovery and direct joins from a separate machine.

features.official_behavior: Play with Friends invite-code tunnel and optional relay
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The bridge disables horizon-client defaults and does not enable the friends feature. Ordinary direct multiplayer is a distinct row.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Evaluate socket, relay, firewall and user consent behavior before enabling the feature.

features.official_behavior: Microsoft account sign-in, Minecraft profile/ownership, session refresh, online-mode join
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The XAML launcher uses device-code sign-in and Credential Locker. Tests of local mocks and a returned device code do not prove full authenticated play on any current build.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Use a consenting supplied account to verify sign-in, refresh and online-mode join.

features.official_behavior: Realms service, availability, notifications, lists and join
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Official source contains an availability check and consumers that require a valid session. Neither previous real service evidence nor a target UWP Realms session is recorded. Compare service transport and active screen wiring before marking support.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Exercise availability, roster and join in a disposable Realm with a real account.

features.official_behavior: Version selection and Minecraft protocol compatibility
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The pinned engine targets Java 26.3. Builder pins a game/asset recipe. The record contains one matched protocol join and does not imply arbitrary Java protocol conversion or Bedrock interoperability.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test exact compatible peers and refusal of mismatched versions.

features.official_behavior: Standalone horizon-server, configuration and host management
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The signed UWP client packages an integrated server. Its packaging flow does not produce the dedicated-server executable or upstream service/hosting tools.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Keep desktop server distribution separate and test client interoperability with it.

features.official_behavior: Vanilla resource packs, data packs and server-required resource packs
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Resource and datapack loading code is shared. Sandboxed discovery/import, per-pack formats and server downloads require explicit tests.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Import a disposable ZIP and accept a server pack on desktop and phone.

features.official_behavior: OptiFine and Polytone resource customizations documented upstream
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared resource modules are carried, but no representative pack pass or individual renderer compatibility matrix exists.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Run the documented resource-pack feature fixtures on each primary backend.

features.official_behavior: Player skins, cosmetics and optional presentation features
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared rendering modules and account path exist. Offline world capture does not exercise online skins, linked Cosmetics or official services.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify local skin drawing separately from profile services and optional cosmetics.

features.official_behavior: Fullbright, dynamic lights, mouse tweaks, sorting, chat animation, zoom detail and other stock extras
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Much of the in-game extras and settings code stays in the shared engine. Pack-migrated extras (FPS, keystrokes, zoom and minimap) add install/manifest/runtime requirements and get no blanket support claim.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify stock extras individually and install the currently documented official mod equivalents.

features.official_behavior: Upstream splitscreen extra and multi-input seat routing
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Upstream exposes the splitscreen extra. The UWP package uses one XAML/CoreWindow host. Split-screen input and rendering were not exercised.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Inspect per-seat surfaces and run two local controllers on a standalone profile.

features.official_behavior: Horizon touch paths where supplied by target platform
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The UWP branch uses in-game touch services and its own Winit integration. The Lumia hardware test confirmed menu taps, MOVE and controller/touch handoff.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Retest true input routing and controller arbitration on the target Nightly.

features.official_behavior: UWP wgpu D3D11 renderer
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The packaged D3D11 path projects the FL9_1 compatibility renderer even on hardware with a higher feature level. Matched x64 multiplayer, x86 title, Surface title and projected world, and strict physical FL9_1 Lumia world are separately documented.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Repeat title and world gates on the refreshed signed artifacts.

features.official_behavior: Official Windows DirectX 12 backend
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: x64 rendered matched multiplayer. Surface signed DX12 ran the title and both hooks, with no world proof in that run. x86 builds can include it, with no matching game evidence. The Lumia host rejected the available ARM32 DX12 adapter.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify x86 and Surface world plus valid timing on hardware DX12.

features.official_behavior: UWP ANGLE over D3D11 with wgpu GLES
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: x64 signed package rendered a matched GLES3 multiplayer scene. It needs pinned DLLs and an EGL window configuration. No staged x86 or ARM64 runtime is verified. Lumia ANGLE surface probe failed. The evidence does not settle alternative driver paths.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Package and test the available alternatives separately. Keep x64 ANGLE explicitly experimental.

features.official_behavior: Official Windows Vulkan and Auto preference
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: UWP build excludes wgpu Vulkan. The XAML launcher picks a packaged backend independently of vanilla graphics API preferences.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Assess a verified AppContainer-compatible Vulkan host/backend before exposing the choice.

features.official_behavior: Official macOS Metal backend
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Metal is an Apple platform API. UWP uses Windows presentation backends.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: No Windows implementation of the Metal backend is required.

features.official_behavior: Earlier separate native D3D11 FL9_1 renderer
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The legacy standalone renderer sources are retained. Nightly selects renderer 3 and omits renderer 0 from packaged builds.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Keep documentation aligned with package feature flags.

features.official_behavior: Graphics tabs, search, focus, Undo and dependencies
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared screen code is carried. Capability-gated rows may be shown even where the old renderer discards their values.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test setting navigation on touch and controller and explain unavailable options at point of use.

features.official_behavior: Full Performance, Performance, Balanced, Quality, Ultra and Custom
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Preset data is shared. The FL9_1 compatibility path ignored world scale and post effects, and high desktop distances are unsuitable for the observed phone profile.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Keep official settings and verify safe device-specific defaults and capability hints.

features.official_behavior: Brightness, GUI scale, weather, clouds, particles, smooth lighting, vignette, blend, distances, entities and chunk fade
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared options and renderer inputs remain. FL9_1 uses its own terrain/entity/HUD shaders and bounded atlas resources. The Lumia's short run does not enumerate each setting or validate desktop presets under memory pressure.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: A/B test representative option families and mobile settings load/save.

features.official_behavior: Distant terrain, far detail, BlueMap and distant plant dither
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The port retains related source. Memory limits and exact visual support for every FL9_1 shader option are unmeasured. Existing desktop scene matches use no far-terrain stress probe.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify each option, then stress a moderate LOD case at matched settings.

features.official_behavior: Mipmap levels, texture filtering and anisotropy
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: FL9_1 packs tiles into bounded sheets and suppresses runtime anisotropy even though sampler settings remain. Modern paths depend on adapter filtering capability.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Expose the FL9_1 limitation and test mipmap/filter distinctions independently.

features.official_behavior: Resolution Scale and native-resolution HUD
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The baseline FL9_1 set_world_post returns before applying scale. The Lumia still presented 2561×1439 at its 50% setting. DX12 and GLES retain the ordinary world-post path. No fixed-scale measurement on those UWP configurations is in the baseline.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Instrument world target versus surface dimensions and verify four fixed scales before adaptive policy.

candidate_statuses.qualification: Full-game candidate status. Production color/depth scaler and one-pixel HUD separation passed offscreen on x64 and x86 Win32 at actual FL9_1 and FL11_1 and signed ARM64 AppContainer at actual FL9_1. Signed ARM32 AppContainer offscreen, 8/8 on Lumia 950 XL physical Adreno 430 FL9_1. Lumia gameplay, output-surface scaling, sustained performance, touch and presentation remain unverified.

component_verification.x64_dx11_fl91: Win32 offscreen, 8/8 native FL9_1 and 8/8 compatibility projection on hardware FL11_1; signed UWP saved world 770 × 510 internal, 1539 × 1020 output, with native and Wasm HUD markers at 50%
component_verification.x86_dx11_fl91: Win32 offscreen, 8/8 native FL9_1 and 8/8 compatibility projection on hardware FL11_1; signed UWP saved world 1154 × 765 internal, 1539 × 1020 output with both HUD markers at 75%
component_verification.arm64_dx11_fl91: Signed ARM64 AppContainer offscreen, 8/8 on Surface Pro X physical FL9_1
component_verification.arm32_dx11_fl91: Signed ARMNT AppContainer offscreen, 8/8 on Lumia 950 XL physical Adreno 430 FL9_1

features.official_behavior: Dynamic Resolution, minimum scale and target FPS
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Upstream derives steps from measured GPU frame time and applies them through world post. FL9_1 has neither the baseline scaled world target nor valid timings. GLES needs a timing-capability probe.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify actual dimensions, labeled timing and stable changes in paired heavy/light scenes.

candidate_statuses.qualification: FL9_1 uses labeled frame pressure when GPU timestamps are unavailable, with bounded scale floor, warm-up, settled samples and confirmation of a scale trial. Ten controller tests and a sizing test passed. No sustained adaptive workload test on a physical game candidate is recorded here.

component_verification.rules: Warm-up, measured-pressure hysteresis, hold for CPU-bound work, confirmed and rejected reductions, stall and interrupted-window handling

features.official_behavior: FXAA before HUD
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The FL9_1 world-post pipeline is disabled. DX12 retains the path. ANGLE behavior depends on the specific adapter and working render targets.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test capability and keep FL9_1 menu truthful.

features.official_behavior: TAA, reprojection, history, TAA upscaling and sharpness
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: FL9_1 disables world post. Modern paths need suitable scene and depth textures. The target adds TAA upscaling under compatible native post-free shader packs.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify native DX12 and scope ANGLE support via feature checks first.

features.official_behavior: 4× opaque/cutout terrain MSAA including eligible native packs
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The official target adds terrain multisampling and explicitly gates OpenGL. FL9_1 baseline predates this implementation and cannot be assumed to satisfy its resolve path. Modern UWP DX12 has source-level feasibility, pending post-migration tests.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify the target's resolve formats on DX12, with its documented single-sample fallback.

features.official_behavior: FSR 3.1 frame generation
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Existing FL9_1 capability gate forces it off. Modern UWP paths retain upstream source. There is no enabled-mode capture in the matched runs. The FL9_1 mission does not add this path.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Retain the gate and test capable backends independently of DRS.

features.official_behavior: HDR, calibration, black/peak/paper/UI whites and looks
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: FL9_1 suppresses HDR output selection. Matched desktop runs used SDR. Modern backend swapchain format and OS display mode determine eligibility.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify in an HDR-capable Windows session and keep SDR behavior separately verified.

features.official_behavior: Horizon WGSL .hshader packs and pack settings
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: FL9_1 rejects native shader packs. Modern renderers retain loader/pipeline code. OpenGL needs per-pack capability checks.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Run a representative stock pack on DX12 and an eligible GLES pack.

features.official_behavior: Iris/OptiFine shader pack compatibility
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: FL9_1 explicitly rejects the pack. Upstream's decoder does not imply support for every Iris/OptiFine pack. No complete signed UWP shader-pack run is recorded.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify terrain, shadows and composite outputs with a known fixture on eligible backends.

features.official_behavior: Pack shadow cache, mirrors, displacement, colored lights and post stages
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: These are pack-selected paths on eligible renderers. FL9_1 pack rejection and strict sampling/shader limits constrain them. Ordinary entity shadow sprites are separate.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Report availability per stage and backend rather than per pack extension alone.

features.official_behavior: Horizon pack ray-tracing stages and runtime resources
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The official shader-pack API describes rays and layers. This is not evidence of DXR support. FL9_1 cannot use the pack pipeline. Modern paths require the pack's declared capabilities and a runtime test.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Validate a documented pack scene only on a compatible backend.

features.official_behavior: Pack compute stages and kept resources
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The pack path depends on declared/adaptor support for compute and storage. FL9_1 rejects the pack and lacks compute. Actual GLES support depends on context.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Check pipeline feature flags before making stages selectable.

features.official_behavior: Menu background blur, entity outlines, spectator and camera post effects
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Baseline gfx disables entity outlines and skips menu blur and spectator post on FL9_1. Default terrain and HUD draw independently.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify modern effects and show unsupported FL9_1 effects as unavailable.

features.official_behavior: Vanilla improved transparency and translucent batching
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Transparency and its renderer paths depend on format/blend support. FL9_1 couples alpha blending and uses compatibility shaders. Exact OIT behavior is unverified.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Use fixed overlapping translucent fixtures across backends.

features.official_behavior: GPU-driven terrain culling, Auto and indirect-count draws
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Official docs require compute and reliable counted indirect draws, and exclude DX12 and GL. FL9_1 does not expose the necessary execution path. CPU visibility remains separate.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify disabled/Auto UI and CPU fallback on signed packages.

features.official_behavior: GPU occlusion and experimental visibility buffer
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Compute and depth-path capabilities differ. FL9_1 lacks the modern world transform and compute paths for the experimental visibility buffer. The baseline evidence does not validate DX12/ANGLE eligibility for every occlusion mode.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Inventory exact per-mode adapter gates before exposing experimental toggles.

features.official_behavior: Cave, frustum, entity, particle, leaf culling and precheck
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The shared engine carries these CPU paths. Async modes, benchmarks and third-party resource-pack compatibility have not been physically compared on the new builds.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test default and stressed world scenes with source-derived assertions.

features.official_behavior: Shulkers, signs, pots, bells, chests, banners and statues
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The shared sources contain independent cache switches. Completed renderer proof does not establish each invalidation, animation or low-memory branch.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Exercise a scene with the documented block entities and resource reload.

features.official_behavior: F2, screenshot quality, world icon capture and new mod screenshot request
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: UWP tests used tool-assisted offscreen screenshot and Device Portal system screenshots. This does not prove F2 writes a user-accessible PNG or that the new hook works. Swapchain readback and staging are backend dependent.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify F2 and mod hook in isolated LocalState, normal and high-resolution modes.

features.official_behavior: VSync, present mode, limiter and frame pacing
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: x64 measured ~60 app Present starts/s with interval 1 in each renderer. That measures application submission, with no display scanout evidence. ARM reports FIFO at startup. Other modes and refresh changes need tests.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify toggle/state persistence and collect display cadence evidence separately.

features.official_behavior: Borderless fullscreen, exclusive fullscreen and mode selection
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The UWP host controls fullscreen through Windows application view APIs. It presents using its XAML/CoreWindow composition path. There is no verified exclusive mode switch or refresh negotiation in the port.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test borderless resizing, verify explicit exclusive-mode UI rejection if unavailable.

features.official_behavior: GPU query timestamps, pass timings and performance overlay
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Compatibility renderers must show GPU n/a when queries are absent. Lumia physically did. Modern backends need adapter feature and valid sample verification. App Present intervals and CPU measurements are distinct metrics.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Check sample validity and truthful labeled DRS fallback on each hardware profile.

features.official_behavior: Texture arrays, floating-point depth, separate alpha and physical texture limits
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: FL9_1 substitutes packed sheets, Depth24Plus and coupled blending. It bounds cube and ordinary 2D texture size. HAL replay passed the retained depthless HUD path on ARM. Modern pipelines have independent feature limits.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify scaled render targets stay within adapter texture and memory limits.

features.official_behavior: Keyboard movement, gameplay keys, shortcuts and remapping
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The port owns a Winit/CoreWindow event path and retains shared binding logic. The native keyboard correction in the product main branch predates this Nightly package series. Its validation remains separate from exact current build evidence.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify gameplay keys, rebinding, shortcuts and held-key release on focus changes.

features.official_behavior: Absolute cursor, raw deltas, look, capture, scroll and sensitivity
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The UWP Winit/window bridge owns the OS event feed. The shared client retains menu/control routing. Screenshots do not validate mouse capture and raw input.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Exercise focus loss, relative camera and wheel on each desktop and tablet backend.

features.official_behavior: Clipboard copy/paste in applicable editing fields
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: UWP uses the platform branch of the clipboard code. Test Unicode and clipboard startup behavior with the real desktop and phone UI.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Copy/paste in chat, world name, and multiplayer address fields.

features.official_behavior: Text composition, IME, chat entry and Windows touch keyboard
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared screens and UWP input exist. A touchscreen menu tap is not a text composition test. The latest Lumia report leaves on-screen keyboard coverage open.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify composition/commit with a second language and open the OS keyboard from chat.

features.official_behavior: Touch menu taps, MOVE, camera, HUD and input switching
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Lumia hardware verified menu taps, movement and switch-away-on-GameSir. Inventory, text entry and every gesture have no equivalent coverage.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Repeat filmed tests for menus, look, movement, inventory, F3 and handoff.

features.official_behavior: Controller sticks, bindings, glyphs, face button swap, radial menu
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: UWP selects its gilrs/platform bridge. Shared mappings remain. GameSir input/handoff is physically proved and mapping/save/load corrections have automated coverage. Individual controller families and radial bindings are unverified.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test GameSir and representative Windows pad families, reload settings and validate F3.

features.official_behavior: Controller on-screen keyboard and UI navigation
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared pad UI and custom keyboard sources remain. The Lumia report leaves this case open and Surface title automation used XAML UI Automation.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Enter chat and dismiss keyboard on all form factors.

features.official_behavior: Gamepad attach, removal, reconnect and focus handling
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Windows.Gaming.Input and the UWP bridge retain lifecycle paths, but the successful handoff run does not prove disconnect, hotplug, reconnect or background edge handling.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Disconnect a pad mid-input and verify release and reconnect.

features.official_behavior: Controller rumble and device vibration
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: A separate Lumia device vibration module has built and passed focused tests, but motor output or standard controller rumble was not physically confirmed.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Observe phone vibration and controller motors on known supported devices.

features.official_behavior: DualSense adaptive triggers, shape haptics, lightbar and LEDs
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Upstream HID extensions are behind the desktop controller dependency. The default UWP game bridge enables uwp-controller instead. The manifest's generic gamepad declaration is not an implementation of those control writes.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Map the supported Windows HID APIs to a narrowly scoped backend with a real DualSense.

features.official_behavior: Xbox One impulse trigger effects
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Uses the upstream optional HID output crate excluded by the UWP controller feature set.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Evaluate Windows-compatible actuator control with actual hardware.

features.official_behavior: F3 debug visibility, overlays, touch button and bindable pad action
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Stock F3/overlay content is available. Lumia implements a touch F3 action and controller binding. Debug output shows unavailable GPU timing correctly.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify default/unassigned behavior and enable/disable through all three input routes.

features.official_behavior: Game narration and screen focus announcements
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The port supplies an inactive narrator instead of using unavailable desktop SAPI. This is a known port gap, with no claim about possible WinRT speech alternatives.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Prototype UWP speech synthesis and verify screen and text narration.

features.official_behavior: Accessibility options, contrast, text scaling, toggle controls and screen focus
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Stock options and TTS-independent controls are present. Narration and input platform paths have their own rows. There is no per-option hardware accessibility suite.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Exercise stock accessibility options using keyboard, controller and touch.

features.official_behavior: Gyroscope camera aim as a standard Horizon mod
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Baseline already has an opt-in Gyrometer host/internal input integration, with no physical aim evidence. No standalone standard gyro aiming mod is part of the baseline. The planned mod should use a narrowed host provider and normal camera path.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test actual yaw/pitch, game focus, disable/re-enable and orientation on Lumia.

candidate_statuses.qualification: Standalone standard native client mod, default off. Uses existing typed render_frame_pre and local rotation methods plus the narrow Gyrometer provider. ARM32 delivery uses Builder native embedding. ARM64, x64 and x86 use signed related-set DLLs or embedding. Physical sensor availability alone does not verify movement, orientation sign, controls, focus or enable/disable behavior in an isolated world.

component_verification.arm64: Surface Pro X WinRT GetDefault found a gyrometer (2 ms minimum report interval), orientation sensor and accelerometer
component_verification.desktop: Ben-Desktop WinRT GetDefault returned no gyrometer; the installed signed game displayed the unavailable-sensor status in a saved world
component_verification.arm32: Signed ARM32 AppContainer found Gyrometer.GetDefault (4 ms minimum) and received event and polled samples. In-world aim proof pending

features.official_behavior: Music, menus and in-world track playback
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The signed Lumia 1.0.0.8 run produced audible menu music. ARM64 mod captures used an audio-disabled fixture. Desktop parity tests did not verify audio.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Record in-world music and menu transitions with sound enabled on every native target.

features.official_behavior: Sound effects and category/master volume
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The user heard sound effects during the phone test. The same shared mixer owns volume. Exact setting tests and a cross-architecture audio run are missing.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: A/B master and category controls and confirm no startup mute or sound dropouts.

features.official_behavior: Bounded music decode/streaming, loop, pause and end-of-stream
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The adapted game decodes into a bounded ~480 KiB stereo PCM queue. The earlier whole-track decode could consume ~61 MiB. Six focused tests and audible phone playback establish this baseline route.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Preserve bounded streaming and measure continuity during world entry and DRS.

features.official_behavior: Spatial attenuation, stereo panning, listener updates and mod sound changes
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared mixer plus UWP XAudio2 default output are carried. Audible SFX do not establish position/distance or every mod sound path.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Play known left/right/distant sources and an isolated mod event.

features.official_behavior: Explicit device picker, switching and hotplug
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The port enables UWP XAudio2 instead of desktop CPAL. Non-CPAL output_devices returns an empty list and set_device stores the name without switching. The default XAudio2 device works on the Lumia.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Add WinRT/compatible endpoint enumeration and explicit XAudio2 switching where possible.

features.official_behavior: Standard .hmod content registries, dependencies and prepared mod assets
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The bounded copier and registry rewriting were tested with a standard entity fixture. Signed x86 D3D11 loaded it alongside both code fixtures and retained the registry ID, command entry and shadow data. ARM content behavior did not get the same fixture proof.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Load and spawn the same content entity in-world on all four native targets.

features.official_behavior: Standard Wasm .hmod manifest, loader, guest ABI and shared stdlib
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Signed fixtures really registered and drew the typed GUI hook on desktop x64/x86 and both ARM devices with Pulley. Execution is revision/ABI-specific and target stdlib requires rebuild validation.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Build exact target ABI fixtures after migration and prove loaded hook/payload in-world.

features.official_behavior: Wasm dependency checks, hash/ABI identity, traps, fuel and memory limits
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Signed x64 proved package rejection and a real hook trap, followed by another rendered frame. Focused AppContainer probes covered bounds and fuel, which still need the same end-to-end coverage on each architecture.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Run malformed and valid local fixtures on each candidate, and verify dependent group behavior.

features.official_behavior: Wasm bundled JIT versus interpreted AppContainer execution
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: UWP deliberately uses Pulley without code-generation capability. ARM32 carries the low-memory override and needs cold-start workload measurements. A desktop JIT binary/native runtime is not interchangeable with the UWP package.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Keep no-JIT route and measure memory, cold startup and failure behavior independently.

features.official_behavior: Mods enabled state, toggle persistence and restart
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Signed x64/x86 preserved exact marker counts across enabled, disabled and re-enabled runs. Lumia first in-process restart hit a global registration seal and required a new process. ARM toggle sequence is unverified.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Retest x64/x86 toggles and complete clean process restart behavior on Surface and Lumia.

features.official_behavior: Trusted standard native Rust sources, exact SDK and engine build identity
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Builder compiles trusted source against the patched game, produces metadata/inventory and validates dependency order. Upstream native binaries are not interchangeable with UWP build identity.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Regenerate the SDK closure and rebuild each fixture against exact Nightly source.

features.official_behavior: Independently shipped signed native DLLs with related-set graph
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Signed x64, x86 and ARM64 used main/optional related sets. Lumia uses embedded trusted code. Phone executable optional-package support is beyond retail Mobile's OS floor, and the baseline build excludes ARM32 packaged loading.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify architecture and SDK checks, signed versions, enable/disable and a new package on each supported device.

features.official_behavior: Builder-time embedded native code and runtime hook registration
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: ARM32 signed package proved typed GUI in-world from a compiled-in fixture. Rebuild is required to change embedded code. For x86/x64 and ARM64 the independent signed route also exists.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Embed the gyro mod and verify native/wasm coexistence in the same world.

features.official_behavior: Load desktop-built native mods or standalone mod DLLs from writable folders
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The UWP host intentionally uses signed package graph or trusted embedding. Related-set loader proof required package relationship metadata, even for a DLL whose package already appeared in the graph.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Keep the signed/embedded routes and explain the required build identities.

features.official_behavior: Standard mod settings, configuration screen and data persistence
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Mods configuration and enabled lists are carried. Only enabled-state persistence on x86/x64 plus person-driven package import on Lumia has detailed evidence. Complete per-setting host capabilities need fixture coverage.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Persist a typed config including defaults and invalid values across isolated launches.

features.official_behavior: Public client hook families, actions, input, GUI, screens, network, sound and local actor
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Typed GUI hook execution is verified on all native targets in the old packages. Other documented families and portable/native-only/side restrictions need compatible fixtures. The exact target introduces graceful quit and screenshot calls.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Exercise exact target hook families in world, including new screenshot and quit calls.

features.official_behavior: Mod pipeline registration, native shader APIs, custom renderers and advanced drawing
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The portable GUI hook works on FL9_1. Advanced rendering and .hshader stages have different caps. No package's GUI marker establishes arbitrary pipelines, scene access or shader compatibility.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test a typed custom renderer without replacing stock drawing and separately test each allowed backend.

features.official_behavior: Native registration, generated injections, slots, advanced mixin-style hooks and unsafe trust boundaries
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Trusted Rust and generated engine contracts exist, with different paths for attached native DLLs and embedded packages. Wasm is limited to the portable contract. No broad fixture coverage proves advanced injections on UWP.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Build architecture-specific registration plus representative mutation/injection fixtures.

features.official_behavior: Target API changes for profiles, stats, structures and diagnostics
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The pinned release introduces these calls. No previous package can verify target APIs, and API source presence alone cannot establish every consumer or Wasm binding.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Regenerate and compare typed signatures and guest capability catalogue, then exercise representative calls.

features.official_behavior: Dependency ordering, missing/different package state, saved-world mismatch, continued runtime
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: x64 related-set dependency ordering is verified and logs confirm invalid Wasm group rejection. Lumia requires a fresh process after certain returns to the launcher. Saved-world mismatch and interoperation need dedicated test fixtures.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Check dependency/version failures and safe restart/reopen without mutating original saves.

features.official_behavior: Official catalog, native bundle trust and launcher-driven install/update
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Builder has registry browsing and trusted native source selection. UWP has import routes. No proof of the desktop launcher's full catalogue/update, author trust, or server modpack export workflow on any UWP cell.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Document available routes and test known public catalog content with explicit fixture versions.

features.official_behavior: Signed client deployment, pinned assets framework and platform dependencies
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Signed x64/x86/ARM64/ARM32 development installations exist with distinct evidence. Neutral asset framework reuse and strict link are packaging steps. These are prior artifacts. November 20 signatures and install proof require new packages.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Strict-link, sign, verify hashes and install each candidate without touching original identities.

features.official_behavior: AppContainer filesystem, installation resources and writable LocalState
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Host resolves packaged assets through the package graph, stores mutable files in isolated data and patches filesystem access for legacy Mobile. Arbitrary desktop paths and roaming data are not equivalent. Previous font fallback was necessary.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify packaged reads, LocalState writes, font fallback and out-of-sandbox error handling.

features.official_behavior: Import files through native pickers and locate/log world data
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The phone user imported the standard .hmod through its launcher picker. No generic parity claim applies to directories, all resource pack types or external save import/export.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Round-trip worlds, mods, packs and a report using platform picker APIs.

features.official_behavior: Open external HTTPS links and launcher actions
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The shell uses Windows.System.Launcher.LaunchUriAsync. The gaming path and app availability on Mobile still matter.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Open a public link and return without game/session loss.

features.official_behavior: Activate, suspend, resume, resize, visibility, orientation and save on exit
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: CoreWindow handlers and renderer surface lifetime code are carried. Mobile landscape and device launch exist. Repeated suspend/resume and resize recovery are open.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Suspend during world play, resume, rotate and quit on isolated packages with stage logging.

features.official_behavior: Multiple windows, launcher/game separation and independent app views
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Pre-game and game intentionally share one app view in the normal host. Retail Mobile has a single-window model. The port's one-window UX is a cross-device packaging choice.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Assess Windows desktop multi-view independently of Mobile.

features.official_behavior: Storage budgets, resource/cache placement and clean error on exhaustion
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Private asset staging uses bounded copying and exact resource identities. Mobile has real terrain/GPU allocation pressure. Builder prior builds reached disk error 112 on multiple volumes.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Reserve dedicated C: scratch, verify free space and measure windowed phone memory under steady play.

features.official_behavior: Background activities, launcher refresh, live tiles and shortcuts
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The XAML launcher refreshes status while running and supports tile metadata. No background-service gameplay or updater equivalent is delivered by that refresh path.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify live tile activation and status on supported Windows versions.

features.official_behavior: Official launcher version management, modpacks, CLI/MCP, provisioning and desktop shortcuts
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The separate Windows Builder and XAML shell divide setup, packaging, version selection and startup work. They do not duplicate all desktop install/upgrade, pack and CLI flows.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Map comparable Builder actions and identify remaining high-value launcher gaps.

features.official_behavior: In-game horizon-ctl command/control socket and desktop launcher MCP
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Shared in-game control sources ship, and prior x64 automation obtained game screenshot/camera evidence. The desktop launcher MCP/CLI and a same-device AppContainer client transport have separate constraints. Device Portal and UI Automation are separate mechanisms.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify local scratch automation through supported UWP transport and report the allowed command subset.

features.official_behavior: CPU timing, frame-time overlay, diagnostic metrics and worker pools
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: ARM uses port worker/thread/stack limits and default supportable graphics settings. Baseline reports actual CPU/wall intervals. Raw DXGI measures application Present cadence. Their timing domains differ.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Collect matched medians and p95/p99 with CPU, wall and GPU kept separate.

features.official_behavior: Worker count, upload budgets, battery mode, and parallel tick
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The official controls are carried where shared core paths permit them. UWP supplies its own worker/stack adaptations and ARM32 batching to fit memory. The baseline contains no cross-architecture setting sweep.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify settings take effect at the required restart, and measure where constrained defaults help.

features.official_behavior: Standard benchmark, profiling, capture/replay and diagnostics export
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The shell offers a standard benchmark and local report storage. The desktop report used ETW after PresentMon emitted no CSV. This does not verify all upstream profiling/replay or uploads from AppContainer.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Test standard benchmark in a marked scratch world and collect reports per architecture.

features.official_behavior: Local crash/panic reports, graphics fallback and recovery
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Lumia fatal reporting recorded the prior shader binding error in LocalState and the log caught device loss. Some process exits produced no panic log. Backend probe failures should remain explicit.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify clean diagnostics for failed probes, device loss and allocation errors.

features.official_behavior: Consent, activity heartbeat, crash/benchmark reporting and platform identity
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: The bridge enables heartbeat with the XAML shell and the consent UI has prior evidence. The design stores relevant reports locally. Remote delivery and current consent transitions have no blanket runtime verification.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Verify local consent behavior and non-transmission paths with test transport.

features.official_behavior: Pipeline/shader compilation, persistence and cold/first startup cost
features.uwp_behavior_and_root_cause: Surfaces and compilation are functional in multiple signed runs. Lumia reports about 45 s first D3D11 pipeline creation. Wasm and resource staging may overlap. No exact target clock comparison exists.
features.feasible_follow_up_and_acceptance: Compare cold/warm shader, guest and content sections without double-counting overlap.

rows: vanilla's graphics preset, render distance, simulation distance, brightness, GUI scale, fullscreen, exclusive fullscreen and its mode, VSync, max framerate, inactivity framerate, menu background blur, attack indicator, autosave indicator

target_candidate.status_scope: Full-game feature acceptance on the November 20 UWP candidate. Component and stock tests stay scoped in their qualifications.
